item.title: New AI Moratorium and Screen-Time Caps Implemented in Public Schools
item.description:
New AI Moratorium and Screen-Time Caps Implemented in Public Schools

Public schools have opened for the new term with a new AI moratorium and screen-time caps now in force.

⚙️ Key details

  • Policies: The school opening includes the implementation of an AI moratorium.
  • Restrictions: Screen-time caps have been put in place.

#AI #PublicSchools #EducationPolicy

Source: The Week in Brooklyn, September 6–13, 2026: Community news | Brooklyn Bridge Parents - News, Events and Family Services
